channel.title: Before Your Menopause Appointment
channel.description:
Short, practical episodes to help you walk into a perimenopause or menopause appointment prepared: how to describe symptoms clearly, what to track, and questions worth asking. General information, not medical advice. Always follow your own clinician's guidance.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of My Midlife Story: Menopause, a free, private iPhone symptom tracker that turns your notes into a one-page visit summary. My Midlife Story: Menopause on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
